g.text: Fetch batch of urls to crawl
- Discover more urls from the seed and add to the corpus of discovered urls
- Ensure rules from robots.txt are followed
- Distribute load across the fleet of workers
- Stateless nodes to fetch the content of a page
- Optionally can generate dynamic content based on
a headless browser for certain urls
- S3 buckets also shared by host
- Since Web is too big, it is unlikely that one host (example.org) can overwhelm a single shard.
- In other words, a shard should be able to handle a ver large host with millions of pages.
- What if there is a host which can go beyond the limit? Let's punt that for the time being.
Splitting a host across multiple shards is also possible. Just need additional handing.
- Use consistent hashing to distribute hosts across multiple shards, so that rebalancing can be
done effectively with minimal content movement.
- The biggest issue could be with S3 buckets. However, instead of moving the already crawled content
the re-destribution across shards can be handled when content is re-crawled.
- Organize pages inside the bucket using prefixes. Use hash of the url path (post host name) as the
prefix to perform listing of content in parallel across multiple discoverers based on prefix filter.
